newsitem.title: NORWAY: Smedvig buys SE Asia drilling firm.
newsitem.headline: Smedvig buys SE Asia drilling firm.

text.p: Norwegian offshore company Smedvig ASA said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to buy Southeast Asian drilling company Petrodril Holdings Inc. and its subsidiaries for 190 million crowns.
Smedvig said it also would take on Petrodril's net debt of 250 million crowns.
Petrodril is a production drilling company, which owns and operates one tender rig, Tiga Kali, and one purpose-built self-erecting semi-submersible, Pelaut.

"The acquisition reflects Smedvig's strategy of international expansion and strengthens the company's activities in the region as well as the company's position within the niche tender rig market," Smedvig said in a statement.
